blocks.text: Sri Vijaya Durga Milk Agency
A local dairy distribution agency serving households, retailers, hotels and other businesses in and around Gundugolanu.
What We Do
Supply milk, curd and dairy products for homes and businesses
Coordinate recurring supply, delivery and customer accounts
Provide clear billing, payment records and service support
Our Service Approach
We focus on careful product handling, dependable local service, clear prices and accurate invoices. Product availability and delivery schedules can vary by route and operating conditions.
Service Area
Gundugolanu, Bhimadolu, Eluru and nearby serviceable locations in Andhra Pradesh.
Talk To Our Team
Use this page for delivery enquiries, account questions, product availability and general business contact.
Phone & Email

Phone: +91 9392890375
Email: svdagencies12@gmail.com
Business Address
Main Road, near Santa Market, beside Srivasa Pesticides, Gundugolanu, Bhimadolu Mandal, Eluru District, Andhra Pradesh - 534427.
Working Hours
Monday to Sunday, 5:00 AM to 9:00 PM. Delivery availability depends on your route and order schedule.
Your Information
We use customer information only to operate dairy supply, delivery, billing, payments and support services.
Information We Use
Name, phone number, delivery address and account details
Orders, invoices, payment references and delivery preferences
Messages or requests sent to customer support
Why We Use It
Information is used to deliver orders, maintain accounts, issue invoices, verify payments, answer support requests and meet accounting or legal record-keeping duties.
Sharing & Security

We do not sell personal information. Limited data may be shared with payment, hosting or delivery service providers only when needed to run the service or meet legal obligations. We use reasonable safeguards, but no online system is completely risk-free.
Your Choices
You may ask us to correct inaccurate account details or raise a privacy question through Contact Support.
Using This Service
These terms apply when you use the customer portal, place an order, view invoices or make a payment to Sri Vijaya Durga Milk Agency.
Customer Responsibilities
Provide correct contact, delivery and account information
Review selected items, quantities and delivery details before submitting an order
Use the portal lawfully and keep account access private
Orders, Prices & Payments

Orders are subject to availability, route coverage and confirmation. Prices, quantities, delivery schedules and invoice amounts are shown in the applicable order or bill. Payments are recorded after successful verification.
Changes & Cancellations
Requests to change or cancel an order must be made before confirmation or dispatch where possible. The Refund Policy explains how approved refunds are handled.
Applicable Law
These terms are governed by the laws of India. We may update them when the service or legal requirements change.
When A Refund Can Be Reviewed
A refund or bill adjustment may be reviewed for an eligible order issue, such as an approved cancellation before dispatch, an incorrect charge, or a verified service problem.
Requesting A Review
Contact support promptly with the invoice or order reference
Describe the issue and provide relevant payment or delivery details
Allow the team to verify the order and payment record
Cases Usually Not Eligible

Refunds may not be available for products already consumed, orders cancelled after dispatch, failed delivery caused by an incorrect address or unavailable customer, or requests raised long after delivery.
Outcome & Timeline

An approved amount may be adjusted against the customer account or returned through the original payment method where appropriate. Reviews normally take 5 to 7 working days after the required details are confirmed.
Local Delivery Service
We deliver dairy products within supported local routes. Delivery timing depends on the selected route, order confirmation, product availability and daily operating schedule.
Before Delivery
An order must be accepted for the applicable route
The delivery address and contact number must be correct
A customer or authorised person should be available to receive the order
Delivery Timing
Estimated times are not guaranteed. Weather, traffic, route conditions, product availability and operational requirements can affect delivery timing.
Unavailable Or Failed Delivery

If the address is incorrect, the phone is unreachable or nobody can receive the order, re-delivery may not be possible on the same day. Please contact support promptly to discuss the available options.
Coverage
Orders outside the agency's active delivery routes may be declined or rescheduled.
